compiled_source_identity: Published parent and testbench bytes equal the respective sources compiled in the qualified local run.
fault_scope: Completion acknowledgement concurrent with abort and later child fault without republishing completion.
Abort before physical acquisition, held metadata request and held vector request; owned traffic drains before reset.
Physical ownership remains protected through held completion and handoff, with attempted memory clobbers and rereads.
limitations: Build and verification durations are host wall times, not accelerator latency or performance.
Inputs, vendor models, journal, witness and numerical checker remain local; public-path rerun and clean-checkout replay are unverified.
Finite integer-interface correctness does not establish general floating-point equivalence or model accuracy.
No predictor rebuild, full model, trained mapped execution, timing, power, paper matching or physical advancement is qualified.
scope: Finite register transfer level integration of streamed signed 32-bit raw and signed 24-bit gain normalization, token merging, compact writes and shared-store ownership.
successor_scope: Dense transport replay of actual retained roots using the same layer-0 operands; no layer-1 or other model execution.

threshold.meaning: Finite diagnostic threshold; no paper calibration claim.
